checks.message: 本文件记录本包在提交前完成的自检。每项给出检查对象、结论与复核方式。凡涉及临时几何、缺失控制条件或无法核验数据的内容，均以 unknown 或 pass 附说明的方式如实记录，不以 pass 掩盖缺口。本条为口径说明，不是质量判定。
checks.message_en: This file records the self-checks completed before submission. Each entry names its target, conclusion and verification method. Provisional geometry, missing controls and unverifiable data are recorded honestly as unknown, or as pass with an explicit caveat, never masked. This entry states the policy and is not a quality judgement.
checks.verification: 本条随文件结构维护，无需外部复核。

checks.message: formal-review-ready 的门槛是：submission_stage=formal，且参赛者可控的四项复核（确定性校验、空间复核、视觉打包、专业证据链）均无 error，且不存在 result=fail 且 severity=blocking 的自检项。unknown 不等于 fail：unknown 表示该结论所依赖的外部条件尚未公布，无法核验；fail 表示已核验且不合格。本包 blocking 级失败为 0，两项 major 级 unknown（CONSTRAINTS_DATA_GAP、OFFICIAL_DATA_RECOMPUTE_PLEDGE）均由组织方几何缺口引起，按 docs/maintainer-workflow.md 的口径，组织方缺少 official boundary/key areas 只形成精度与复算警示，不阻断内容评分。这两项保留 unknown 是刻意的诚实披露，不会因为要凑齐全 pass 而改写为 pass。
checks.message_en: The formal-review-ready threshold is: submission_stage=formal, no errors in the four participant-controlled reviews (deterministic validation, spatial review, visual packaging, professional evidence), and no self-check with result=fail at blocking severity. unknown is not fail: unknown means the external condition the conclusion depends on has not been published and cannot be verified; fail means verified and non-compliant. This package has zero blocking failures, and its two major unknowns (CONSTRAINTS_DATA_GAP, OFFICIAL_DATA_RECOMPUTE_PLEDGE) both arise from organiser geometry gaps, which per docs/maintainer-workflow.md yield precision and recomputation advisories rather than blocking content scoring. Both are kept as unknown deliberately and will not be rewritten as pass merely to present an all-pass sheet.
checks.verification: self_check_submission.py 返回 Result: PASS、Review status: formal-review-ready、Can enter formal review: YES；validate_submission.py 与 participant_preflight.py 均为 PASS。

checks.message: manifest.validation_claim.data_confidence 取包级下限口径，现为 medium，与 metrics.json 中依赖临时边界的指标（site_area_sqm、green_ratio、public_space_ratio 等 31 项 medium、6 项 low）一致，不再声明 high。字段级置信度仍以 metrics.json 每项的 confidence 为准：high 10 项（均为不依赖临时边界的计数与公告口径值）、medium 31 项、low 6 项（重点区临时几何与建筑基底示意）、unknown 10 项。validation_claim.self_checked 现为 true，对应四项复核已实际跑通并全部 PASS。
checks.message_en: manifest.validation_claim.data_confidence now states the package-level floor, medium, consistent with the boundary-dependent metrics in metrics.json (31 medium, 6 low), and no longer claims high. Field-level confidence remains authoritative per metric: 10 high (counts and announced figures that do not depend on the provisional boundary), 31 medium, 6 low (provisional key-area geometry and indicative building footprints), 10 unknown. validation_claim.self_checked is now true, matching the four reviews that were actually run and all passed.
checks.verification: 逐项比对 manifest.validation_claim 与 metrics.json 的 confidence 分布；self_checked 对应 self_check_submission.py 的 PASS 输出。

checks.message: 指标复算口径：交换坐标系 EPSG:4326，面积与长度计算坐标系 EPSG:4548。所有 known 空间指标均由提交的 GeoJSON 在 EPSG:4548 下复算得到，不从正文文字抄录；官方边界与重点区 polygon 发布后必须整体重算。指标按 metric_class 分三类：class_1_recomputable 为可由提交几何直接复算的空间指标，class_2_pending_official_control 为需官方控规或任务书附件支撑的管控指标，class_3_operational_performance 为需运营或产业数据持续校准的绩效指标。
checks.message_en: Metric recomputation protocol: exchange CRS EPSG:4326, area and length CRS EPSG:4548. Every known spatial metric is recomputed from the submitted GeoJSON in EPSG:4548, never copied from narrative text, and all values must be recomputed once official boundary and key-area polygons are published. Metrics carry metric_class: class_1_recomputable for spatial metrics recomputable from the submitted geometry, class_2_pending_official_control for controls requiring an approved regulatory plan or brief annex, class_3_operational_performance for performance metrics requiring operational or industry data.
checks.verification: spatial_review.py 在 EPSG:4548 下复算六项核心指标并与 metrics.json 比对，无 METRIC_RECALC_MISMATCH。
